card.name: Time phrases like at any time
card.fires_on: Small words (at, to, for, same) that start or sit inside a time-span phrase such as "at any given time", "at least", "to this day", "at the same time" or "at present". It appears in general web prose.

modes.label: at + time phrase
modes.description: The word "at" after a clause, leading into a phrase like any given time, present, that time, or least.
modes.example: are being trafficked around the world<< at>> any given time.

modes.label: Other time-span openers
modes.description: "to", "for" or "same" inside phrases like to this day, for centuries, at the same time.
modes.example: bears his name<< to>> this day.

card.plain: It marks small words that begin a phrase about when or for how long something holds, like "at the same time" or "to this day".
